brief: Out of 273 actionable NYC lots screened, we are advancing four high-scoring sites for outreach this week. These selections target motivated private sellers under 485-x Option C and City of Yes UAP, a high-headroom faith-owned ground lease JV, and a 67-unit city-owned RFP site. All financial frames reflect preliminary screening estimates subject to formal diligence.

targets.play: Develop a 7-unit small building utilizing the 485-x Option C tax exemption with 50 percent rent-stabilized units and market rents.
targets.negotiation: Target bid at or below the estimated land cost of $952,680, with a strict max offer cap of $1,047,948 based on a 1.96 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify site condition and existing structure status prior to mailing.

targets.play: Deliver a 19-unit residential project taking advantage of City of Yes UAP 20 percent FAR bonus stacked with 485-x.
targets.negotiation: Offer framed around the $2,519,465 estimated land cost, capping negotiations at the $2,771,411 max offer with 1.76 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify sewer connection capacity and street width parameters for the FAR bump.

targets.play: Structure a ground-lease joint venture with the church owner serving as the 51 percent qualified partner under HPD Neighborhood Builders Fast Track.
targets.negotiation: Do not submit a standard cash buyout; present a JV structure referencing the $353,574 land valuation and $388,931 max offer frame supported by 6.54 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify institutional-owner approval and board authorization for a long-term ground lease.

targets.play: Position for a 67-unit city-owned disposition leveraging City of Yes UAP and 485-x tax incentives.
targets.negotiation: Do not submit a private purchase offer; contact the local Council member and Community Board to track RFP release schedules.
targets.risk: Verify municipal zoning restrictions and public agency disposition requirements.

process_note: Acquisitions will complete zoning and site condition checks today before mailing owner letters and setting council meetings.
